title: ID0389681-DC/Si-D/DE[170001715] - ELMS configuration
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: ELMS activation
Root cause:
set the charger to energy/load management and initially set the fallback value to 100kW. Please also tell me the IP that we need to set in our energy management in order to be able to ping the column.
Solution:
Possibly the Ethernet cable is not connected on XF3 WAN port
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:
no

additional_info.subject: ID0389681-DC/Si-D/DE[170001715] - ELMS configuration CRM:00315002049
additional_info.body:
Dear Michael, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center - ERK
Main Asset
:
MP / R4 170001715
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
We0Dpl
Problem Description
: Activate ELMS (External load management system)
Troubleshooting
:
I am not able to activate the ELMS right now due to a charging session ongoing. When there are no charging sessions I can activate it.
Here is the information I need from your side:
VLAN IP = Controller IP address for the SiD to communicate (any IP works as long as it's configurated in the controller)
Ports = default is 400
Please make sure of the following as well,
connect the Ethernet cable on the WAN port of the
XF3
, otherwise it will not work.
After the ethernet cable is connected, the registers should be readeable from the controller-side.
You are not able to ping the charger as the firewall blocks this communication, you are only able to read the registers.
I send you the document, in attachment, so that you can read for all the registers and additional informations.
For future reference, your ticket number is
0389681
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
Please do not
change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.
